about:
It’s a playful platform where students and pet owners can connect – not for forever, but for a little quality time.

Whether you want to borrow a dog for a sunny afternoon walk, find someone to care for your turtle while you’re away, or simply meet a new furry friend nearby – MietMiez brings pets and people together.

Users can browse listings of available animals, filter by location, personality, or pet type, and get in touch with local owners. Each listing includes cute photos, quirky traits (“Cuddly”, “Calm”, “Possibly edible”), and specific care instructions.

Developed as part of a university course, MietMiez combines responsive design, secure user accounts, geo APIs, and a simple user experience to explore the idea of temporary pet sharing – responsibly, safely, and with a smile.

Privacy Notice – MietMiez

1. Data Controller
The data controller responsible for processing your personal data is MietMiez, a project operated by the MietMiez Team.

For privacy-related questions, you can contact our data protection officer at: privacy@mietmiez.de

⸻

2. Purposes and Legal Basis for Data Processing
We process personal data to provide you with access to MietMiez, our platform facilitating student rentals. Specifically, we use your data to manage rental agreements, user accounts, support requests, and to ensure system security.

Legal bases under the GDPR are:
- Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): Processing is necessary to provide the services you requested.
- Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): Ensuring security, preventing misuse, and internal administration.

⸻

3. Categories of Personal Data
We process the following categories of personal data:
Contact information (name, email, phone number, address), Payment information for processing rental payments, Rental booking data (requests, confirmed bookings), Technical data (IP address, browser details, device information, usage logs)

⸻

4. Recipients of Personal Data
We share your personal data only when strictly necessary, including: Payment service providers (e.g., PayPal, Stripe) to handle transactions, Hosting providers and IT services located within the EU, Authorities or courts when legally required

Data transfers to countries outside the EU only occur if an appropriate level of data protection is guaranteed (e.g., EU Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions).

⸻

5. Data Retention Periods
We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes stated: Contract and booking data: stored for up to 5 years due to legal retention obligations, User account data: retained as long as your account is active, and deleted no later than one year after account inactivity, Technical data (log files): retained for 12 months, after which they are anonymized or deleted

⸻

6. Your Rights under the GDPR
You have the right to: Request access to your data (Art. 15 GDPR), Request correction, deletion, or restriction of your data (Art. 16–18 GDPR), Object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR), Request data portability (Art. 20 GDPR), Withdraw consent at any time (Art. 7 GDPR), Lodge a complaint with the appropriate data protection supervisory authority

⸻

7. Obligation to Provide Data
Providing certain personal data is necessary to use MietMiez (e.g., payment information). Failure to provide such data may prevent you from using the platform.

⸻

8. Automated Decision-Making and Profiling
We do not conduct automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects or significantly affects you.

⸻

If you have further questions about your data or this privacy notice, please contact us at: contact@mietmiez.de
